review.summary: The patch fixes incorrect argument passing to the Rmath studentized-range functions: `Rmath.ptukey`/`qtukey` take `nranges` as a positional argument in the Julia wrapper, so the existing calls silently shifted the `lower_tail`/`log_p` Bool flags into the `nranges` slot. All eight srdist wrappers (cdf, ccdf, logcdf, logccdf and their inverses) return wrong values before the fix. Adding the explicit `1` restores the documented semantics without changing any public signature.
review.evidence: Single-file, single-hunk production change in src/distrs/srdist.jl inserting the missing `nranges` positional argument in 8 call sites; no API surface change, no new exports, no refactor. Accompanying test change in test/rmath.jl indicates behavior is asserted against Rmath reference values. Runtime evidence reports strict_differential=stable_differential over 3 repetitions with a dedicated trigger script, and the full suite passing at the fixed revision, which is consistent with a genuine pre-existing wrong-answer bug rather than a flaky or environment-dependent difference. Minimization reports all hunks necessary and globally minimal, so the fix is isolated. The added source comment is explanatory only and rides along with the behavioral change.

review.validation_risks: Because trigger test identifiers are not listed, the harness must derive them from test/rmath.jl, which may exercise many distributions and could produce broader failures than the srdist functions alone. Behavior depends on the Rmath_jll binary and the Rmath.jl wrapper signature, so results are toolchain-version sensitive: a different Rmath.jl version with keyword or defaulted `nranges` could make the pre-fix code pass and break the differential. Comparisons against reference quantiles may also be tolerance-sensitive, particularly for the log-scale inverse functions.
review.suggested_tests: Assert srdistcdf/srdistccdf sum to 1 and that srdistlogcdf/srdistlogccdf equal log of the corresponding non-log values for several (k, nu, x) combinations. Round-trip srdistinvcdf(srdistcdf(k, nu, x)) approx x and the ccdf/log variants likewise. Pin at least one hardcoded R-derived reference value for ptukey and qtukey (for example k=3, nu=10) so an argument shift is caught directly. Add a monotonicity check in x for the cdf and confirm output type promotion for mixed Int/Float32/Float64 inputs.
